products.name: OXO Good Grips Expandable Utensil Drawer Organiser
products.summary: A removable-tray organiser for cutlery, utensils and small loose items once the drawer width, depth and 6 cm clearance have been checked.
drawbacks: Its 6 cm height and wide expanded footprint will not suit every drawer.
It is designed to be wiped clean rather than used as a dishwasher-safe tray.
The open section will not resolve mixed, excess contents by itself.

suits: drawers holding a mix of cutlery, irregular tools and small kitchen gadgets
households that want removable sections for setting the table or cleaning
mayNotSuit: shallow drawers or drawers with runner, screw or curved-side obstructions
households needing a fixed cutlery-only layout

products.name: Joseph Joseph DrawerStore Expanding Cutlery, Utensil & Gadget Organiser
products.productType: Expanding cutlery, utensil and gadget organiser
products.summary: An expanding tray with deep cutlery and gadget compartments for drawers with at least 7.5 cm internal height.
drawbacks: It needs a minimum internal drawer height of 7.5 cm and still depends on the drawer's actual width and depth.
Long or unusually shaped tools may need another solution.
It should be hand washed and dried rather than treated as a dishwasher-safe insert.

suits: households sorting cutlery, small utensils and kitchen gadgets in one drawer
drawers with enough height for the tray and enough width for its expanding sides
mayNotSuit: drawers dominated by long-handled utensils or oversized knife handles
